scenarioSurface.capabilityName: Deliver capsule estate operations through MCP stdio
scenarioSurface.scenarioName: Start the admitted capsule estate MCP stdio server

input.text: the sidefx-capsule-estate server authority at version 0.1.0, MCP protocol 2025-11-25, stdio transport, and an admitted operate-capsule-estate binding

outcome.text: the server connects through standard input and output, advertises tool-list change support, and remains available after each governed tool outcome

scenarioSurface.notes:
An agentic client receives one MCP stdio server whose exact identity,
  protocol, tools, descriptions, input schemas, annotations, and operation
  bindings come from the admitted MCP interface authority. MCP delivery owns
  protocol carriers only; operate-capsule-estate owns every capsule operation.

tools.name: sidefx_capsules_verify
tools.title: Verify SideFX capsule estate
tools.description: Verify the durable capsule-only layout, every capsule and entry digest, and declared dependency resolution.

tools.name: sidefx_capsules_list
tools.title: List SideFX capsules
tools.description: List admitted capability capsules, optionally filtering capability IDs by a case-insensitive substring.

tools.name: sidefx_capsule_inspect
tools.title: Inspect one SideFX capsule
tools.description: Return identity, lineage, dependencies, runtime binding, fixtures, and content-addressed entry metadata for one capsule.

tools.name: sidefx_capability_test
tools.title: Test capsule-carried capabilities
tools.description: Run admitted fixtures for selected capsule-carried capabilities in an owned disposable reconstruction root.

tools.name: sidefx_capability_invoke
tools.title: Invoke a capsule-carried capability
tools.description: Invoke one admitted capability with a canonical input carrier. The selected capability may execute declared external effects; obtain authorization before calling it.
